rust.role: fixed golden structure only; Unicode 18 tables are never used

dispositions.identical: All raw oracle results retained separately from identical expected results; no tailoring or normalization.

spec.casing: Upper/lower combine UnicodeData simple mappings with all unconditional SpecialCasing mappings, including one-to-many expansions. Lowercase also applies Final_Sigma: U+03A3 maps to U+03C2 when preceded by a Cased character and not followed by a Cased character, ignoring Case_Ignorable characters on both sides; otherwise it maps to U+03C3. Context comes from the original input slice. These functions have no locale tailoring.
spec.folding: `casefold` applies the full default CaseFolding C+F mappings, excluding simple-only and Turkic mappings. `eq_ignore_case(a, b)` is `casefold(a) == casefold(b)`. Neither operation normalizes: `Straße` and `STRASSE` compare equal, while precomposed `é` and decomposed `e\u{301}` require explicit normalization.

boundary_exception: Two fixed Rust ASCII-prefix witnesses have 17/18 total scalars (16/17 ASCII plus sigma); all other strings have 0–16. These are the explicitly required prefix boundaries, not added random scope.
